message.content: WolfgangSchulz is the individual who informs LiHua that the new software he has been working on is almost complete. This is evident from the conversation in the data table with the timestamp "Time: 20261002_13:00", where WolfgangSchulz expresses his excitement about the near-completion of the software and mentions that LiHua will be one of the first to use it.
